themes.name: Price / fees

brief.title: FreshCart: Smart Substitutions
brief.recommendation: Build smart substitutions next quarter. Let customers pre-approve a backup per item or mark it do-not-substitute.
brief.problem: Bad substitutions are the number one driver of negative feedback. Customers receive items they did not choose, at prices they did not agree to, and in several cases with allergy and dietary risk.

claims.text: Substitution complaints account for 68 of 182 feedback items in the last 90 days.
41% of shoppers reduced order frequency after poor substitutions.
claims.quote: 41% of online grocery shoppers said poor item substitutions led them to reduce their order frequency over the past year.

claims.text: InstaFresh lets customers pre-approve a substitute per item.
claims.quote: Customers can pre-approve a preferred substitute for any item before checkout.

claims.text: 62% of FreshCart users churn after a single bad substitution.
claims.quote: The report found that 62% of users churn after a bad substitution experience.

options.name: Do nothing
options.note: Complaint volume continues; allergy incidents remain an open liability.

options.name: Shopper texts before every swap
options.note: Cheap, but slows fulfilment and does not scale past a few swaps per order.

options.name: Smart substitutions (recommended)
options.note: Per-item pre-approval or do-not-substitute. Matches the competitor baseline. Removes the guesswork from the shopper.

brief.ask: Two engineers and one designer for one quarter. Ship per-item substitution preferences at checkout, with do-not-substitute as a first-class option.
